note_tweet.text:
Base-conversion arithmetic breaks most small reasoning models.

There’s no base-10 shortcut, so every carry has to be worked through directly in the target base. Most small models skip the carry logic, or convert back to base-10 at the end and hope.

TwIL-LM3-Pro doesn’t. It walks each step in the target base and holds state across the derivation.

The same pattern shows up across our full formal logic suite. TwIL-LM3-Pro leads every model we tested on in-domain formal logic, including Qwen3-8B at 2x the parameters, gpt-oss-120b at 33x the parameters, and both VibeThinker variants.

A 3.66B model built for formal reasoning, beating models 33x its size at it.

And even on held-out general reasoning benchmarks we didn’t build for, it stays competitive with those same larger models.

Pattern matching gets you fluent answers. Formal reasoning gets you right ones.

Open weights, runs locally.

Download the model on @huggingface: https://t.co/pTRuIDyV0L

We’ve been building toward the opposite.

A model that fits in RAM, answers in seconds, and can be understood end to end gets us closer to what AI should actually be: specialized, local, and yours.

note_tweet.text:
We ran TwIL on a CPU with 15 GiB of RAM. No GPU. It generated tokens 98x faster than Qwen3.8-27B on the same hardware.

The test:
- Intel Xeon CPU, 4 threads
- 15 GiB RAM
- No GPU

Results:
- TwIL-LM3-Pro (2.24 GB weights): 10.47 tokens per second
- Qwen3.5-9B (5.67 GB weights): 4.36 tokens per second
- Qwen3.8-27B (16.45 GB weights): 0.107 tokens per second

TwIL and Qwen 9B both run at the RAM's memory limit of about 24 GB/s. Qwen 9B is 2.4x slower only because its weights are 2.5x larger.

Qwen 27B's 16.45 GB of weights don't fit in the 15 GiB of RAM. Parts have to be re-read from disk for every token. Size alone would make it 7.3x slower. The disk reads add another 13x. Total: 98x slower than TwIL.

With enough RAM, the gap would shrink to about 7x. But most people don't have unlimited RAM, and most people don't have a top-tier GPU. The model you can actually fit matters more than the one you can't.

Download TwIL-LM3-Pro on @huggingface: https://t.co/pTRuIDyV0L

note_tweet.text:
TwIL-LM3 has been downloaded nearly 80,000 times since we released it.

TwIL-LM3 judges reasoning. Give it a chain of logic and it can tell you whether the conclusion follows and the proof steps hold up, then explain in plain English. Specialist models like this usually run in the background. TwIL-LM3 can work directly with people while still handling the formal reasoning underneath.

Here's where developers, researchers, and teams are using it:

Judgment tasks — deciding whether a logical claim or proof step actually holds up rather than just sounding convincing.

Mixed products — anywhere the same interface needs to answer everyday questions AND handle formal reasoning without switching models.

Explanations — turning the output of a solver or formal reasoner into something a person can understand.

TwIL-LM3 doesn't replace a real verifier for safety-critical work, but for everything else it gives you a checkable answer.

It's fast, concise, and runs on your device.

Get the model on @huggingface: https://t.co/U7H7M0gkun
